profile.Name: James the Warden
profile.Job: Warden of the Highlanders Prison Camp
profile.Personality: A boastful bounty hunter who calls himself the champion of all bounty hunters. He talks of peace and justice but dreams of the reward.
profile.Backstory: An officer of the Highlanders who keeps their prison camp. The Highlanders set out as bounty hunters bringing justice to lawless lands but turned to slave trading for profit.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls his targets "outlaw" or "criminal scum" and offers them the easy way or the hard way. Promises every catch a trip to jail.
